recent_posts.title: Release v0.161.1 · gohugoio/hugo
recent_posts.summary: Hugo v0.161.1 is a patch release with four changes: resources.GetRemote now honors the Retry-After HTTP header during retries, the warpc module migrates to the parson.c JSON library, a new AllowChildProcess option is added to security.node.permissions config, and the default HTTP URL security rule for '@' denial is narrowed to apply only to userinfo rather than the full URL.

recent_posts.title: Release v0.161.0 · gohugoio/hugo
recent_posts.summary: Hugo v0.161.0 ships two security hardening changes: Node tools (PostCSS, Babel, TailwindCSS) now run with the --permission flag using permissions defined in security.node.permissions, requiring Node >= 22, and the TailwindCSS standalone executable is no longer supported (must use the Node.js package). Default security.http.urls restrictions are also tightened. Bug fixes address i18n translation lookup, non-deterministic conflict detection in 'hugo new content', environment isolation for config settings, and filename dimension identifier issues. Improvements include nested hugo:vars/ CSS imports, better i18n language fallback, slice-based permalinks config with PageMatcher, and various dependency updates.

recent_posts.title: Release v0.160.0 · gohugoio/hugo
recent_posts.summary: Hugo v0.160.0 is a patch/minor release with three bug fixes: Position issues, double-escaping of ampersands in Goldmark link URLs, and stray quotes from partial decorators in script context. Improvements include support for @import "hugo:vars" for CSS custom properties in css.Build, extended .Position handling in Goldmark render hooks, and internal test refactoring. Several dependency bumps are also included.

recent_posts.title: Release v0.159.0 · gohugoio/hugo
recent_posts.summary: Hugo v0.159.0 release includes deprecation replacements in tests (site.Data → hugo.Data, excludeFiles/includeFiles → files, :filename → :contentbasename), bug fixes such as returning errors instead of panics when a page is not found, preserving non-content files in convert output, and several dependency updates including goldmark, grpc, and golang.org/x/image.

recent_posts.title: Release v0.158.0 · gohugoio/hugo
recent_posts.summary: Hugo v0.158.0 is released with a notable upgrade to Go 1.26.1. Key bug fixes include resolving external source maps in CSS, fixing server watch mode, addressing context cancellation on GetRemote with per-request timeouts, and fixing a SIGSEGV crash in the warp dispatcher. Major improvements include the addition of a new css.Build function, allowing users to override single loader entries, improved default loader resolution for CSS @import and url(), support for regular pages cascading to self, a new strings.ReplacePairs template function, and an upgrade of the CLDR locales library from v36.1 to v48.1. Several dependencies were also bumped including esbuild, golang.org/x tools, and imagemeta.

recent_posts.title: Release v0.157.0 · gohugoio/hugo
recent_posts.summary: Hugo v0.157.0 introduces GitInfo support for Hugo Modules, allowing Page.GitInfo to work with content sourced from Git modules. Other improvements include partial support for AVIF, HEIF, and HEIC image formats (metadata only), adjusted WebP processing defaults, a per-request timeout option for resources.GetRemote, and better error messages for module downloads. Bug fixes address menu pageRef resolution in multidimensional setups and automatic section page replacement issues.

recent_posts.title: Release v0.156.0 · gohugoio/hugo
recent_posts.summary: Hugo v0.156.0 is primarily a spring cleaning release focused on API simplification. It delivers performance improvements to collections.Where and collections.Sort, removes template functions and site methods deprecated since v0.136.0 (including data.GetCSV, data.GetJSON, crypto.FNV32a, resources.Babel, resources.PostCSS, resources.ToCSS, and several Page/Site methods), and introduces new deprecations for Site.AllPages, Site.BuildDrafts, Site.Languages, Site.Data, and Site.Sites. Additional changes include upgrading to Go 1.26, switching from MD5 to xxhash for in-memory keys, improved lineNos highlight options, and several bug fixes.

recent_posts.title: Release v0.155.3 · gohugoio/hugo
recent_posts.summary: Hugo v0.155.3 fixes several bugs including an issue with default site redirects for non-primary HTML output formats, a stuck server global error logging problem, and a panic in the server browser error handler. The release also updates the esbuild dependency from 0.27.2 to 0.27.3.

recent_posts.title: Release v0.155.2 · gohugoio/hugo
recent_posts.summary: Hugo v0.155.2 fixes a bug affecting the version and role dimensions introduced in v0.153.0. The bug only impacted changes to non-primary versions and roles, while multiple languages and first version/role changes worked correctly.

recent_posts.title: Release v0.155.1 · gohugoio/hugo
recent_posts.summary: Hugo v0.155.1 is a patch release that fixes several image processing issues. The update resolves a WebP image DecodeConfig regression affecting images loaded from file cache, fixes the useSharpYuv parameter being ignored for WebP images, and includes template-related improvements. The release is available across multiple platforms with binaries for Linux, macOS, Windows, FreeBSD, OpenBSD, NetBSD, and DragonFly BSD.

top_posts.title: Release v0.123.3 · gohugoio/hugo
top_posts.summary: Release v0.123.3 of Hugo includes bug fixes, support for JSX and JSXImportSourceOptions in the js module, and a new config option called capitalizeListTitles.

top_posts.title: Release v0.125.3 · gohugoio/hugo
top_posts.summary: Release v0.125.3 of gohugoio/hugo fixes a security issue related to XSS injection from Markdown content files.
